about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a passionate Full Stack Developer with experience designing and developing web applications, REST APIs, cloud-based systems, and AI-powered software.

I enjoy solving real-world business problems through clean architecture, intuitive user experiences, and modern technologies. My focus is on building reliable, maintainable, and high-performance applications that deliver measurable value.
about.quote: Good software doesn't just solve problems; it provides intuitive solutions through thoughtful engineering.

projects.title: NeuralFlow v2
projects.tagline: Self-optimizing inference engine designed for edge deployment.
projects.description: An advanced AI project that enables lightning-fast inference on edge devices by automatically optimizing model weights and operations in real-time.
projects.longDescription: NeuralFlow v2 addresses the challenges of deploying heavy neural network models to constraint-oriented edge nodes. Built on a hybrid Rust-Python architecture, it performs model quantization, pruning, and layout optimization in flight. Through automated caching and pipeline profiling, it minimizes power draw and maximizes hardware utilization without sacrificing model accuracy.

projects.title: QuantDashboard
projects.tagline: Real-time financial analytics platform with sub-100ms latency.
projects.description: A high-performance web dashboard displaying real-time stock and cryptocurrency trends, portfolio valuations, and risk calculations.
projects.longDescription: QuantDashboard is designed for proprietary trading desks and retail investors who require instant market data. Employing binary WebSocket protocols and React 19 concurrent rendering, the platform streams over 10,000 tick updates per second to the client side. Web Workers process incoming data off the main thread, maintaining fluid 60fps animations for charting and visualizations.

projects.title: DevEngine CLI
projects.tagline: Command-line interface for automating complex cloud deployments.
projects.description: A developer tool designed to bootstrap microservices, configure infrastructure-as-code, and manage deployments securely from the terminal.
projects.longDescription: DevEngine CLI simplifies cloud orchestrations by consolidating multiple provider workflows into a single terminal utility. Developers can configure resources, create databases, establish SSL certificates, and link repositories in seconds. Built-in encryption secures environment variables and credentials locally before transmitting them to container clusters.

projects.title: ERP Platform
projects.tagline: Enterprise resource planning software for medium-sized businesses.
projects.description: A comprehensive cloud ERP to streamline inventories, track customer relationships, manage finances, and generate detailed reports.
projects.longDescription: This cloud-native ERP platform helps businesses integrate core operations under one portal. It includes general ledger accounting, automated procurement loops, real-time inventory adjustments, and extensive permission controls for diverse department managers. A highly reliable PostgreSQL schema keeps transactional data consistent even during peak usage hours.

projects.title: Learning Management System
projects.tagline: Modern LMS with student portal, instructor dashboard, and analytics.
projects.description: An education portal supporting course creation, interactive quizzes, automated grading systems, and detailed tracking of student engagement.
projects.longDescription: Designed to modernize institutional teaching, this LMS supports video hosting, live classrooms, peer discussion rooms, and submission feedback cycles. It processes media formats cleanly and offers instructors automated progress dashboards that highlight students who might require extra attention or assistance.

projects.title: AI Business Assistant
projects.tagline: AI chatbot interacting with ERP systems and generating insights.
projects.description: An intelligent virtual assistant integrated directly with corporate databases, capable of generating business summaries, answering audits, and fetching records.
projects.longDescription: This chatbot utilizes Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to query private enterprise data securely. Instead of training custom models, it formats SQL queries from natural language, cross-references files, and outputs graphs directly in chat interface, enabling executives to pull real-time data reports within seconds.
